objective: Validate audible cue, hotcue, loop and jog behavior on the real Windows/browser/audio path while preserving Deck A/B and SYNC invariants.
setup: Check out the exact requested SHA.
Run python bootstrap.py; require LIBERTAS BOOT: PASS.
Run npm install && npm run check.
Start Vite and open headed Edge/Chrome on the normal physical audio output.
Record Windows/browser/output identity, AudioContext sample rate, base/output latency and render quantum.

tests.instructions: Load an ordinary local audio file into Deck A. Play it, set Cue at a clearly recognizable point, play farther, trigger Cue Return, then set and trigger Hot Cue 1 at another recognizable point.
pass: Cue Return audibly returns to the stored point and pauses.
Hot Cue 1 audibly jumps to its stored point while preserving play state.
No stuck transport, crash, or unexpected state change.
cueTriggerCount/hotCueTriggerCount/performanceJumpCount change exactly as commanded.

tests.instructions: Use generated 120 BPM click material with the known manual grid. Enable a 4-beat loop and listen through repeated wraps.
pass: Loop remains inside the expected source-frame interval.
Loop wraps repeatedly and loopWrapCount increases.
No new frameDiscontinuities.
No unexpected pause or end-of-track.

tests.instructions: Run a generated beat loop continuously for at least five minutes.
pass: Loop remains active and responsive for the full interval.
No progressive timing drift or transport stall.
No new worklet frame discontinuities.
Human reports no abnormal clicks/dropouts beyond the intended musical loop boundary.

tests.instructions: On an ordinary local track while playing, exercise -50 ms and +50 ms jog repeatedly, then one larger bounded jog in each direction.
pass: Play state remains running.
Source frame moves in the requested direction and clamps at PCM limits.
jogCount increases only for explicit jog actions.
No browser/audio stall.

tests.instructions: Run both decks. Exercise cue/hotcue/loop/jog on one deck while the other continues playing.
pass: Untouched deck continues without jump, pause, rate change, or reset.
Mixer continues producing physical output.
No new A/B/mixer discontinuities.

tests.instructions: While a loop is active and audible, capture status, run the provided 600 ms main-thread block, capture again, and listen.
pass: Loop remains enabled and inside its boundaries.
Audio continues through the stall.
0 new deck/mixer frame discontinuities.
No audible dropout caused by the UI stall.

tests.instructions: Using generated click tracks and their trusted grids, lock B to A with SYNC. Record follower transportSeekCount and performanceJumpCount, trigger an explicit Hot Cue on follower B, then allow SYNC to re-lock.
pass: performanceJumpCount increases by the explicit command.
transportSeekCount does not increase from SYNC recovery.
SYNC resumes tracking/re-locks.
No hidden corrective seek.

evidence_required: Human audible confirmation for cue, hotcue, loop, jog and five-minute loop hold.
Loop start/end, loopWrapCount delta and discontinuity delta.
Jog deltas/count and resulting source frames.
SYNC explicit-jump before/after performanceJumpCount and transportSeekCount.
report_rules: Do not patch product/system code from the report branch.
Push the report branch so the runner-backed debug bus relays it to issue #1.
